item.title: CA delays revoking 17,000 commercial driver's licenses until March after immigrants sue
item.description: A week after immigrant groups filed a lawsuit, California said Tuesday it will delay the revocations of 17,000 commercial driver's licenses until March to allow more time to ensure that truckers and bus drivers who legally qualify for the licenses can keep them.

item.description: The Bay Area tech giant declined to disclose financial details of the acquisition, but a report said that Meta closed the deal at more than $2 billion.

item.title: California will start 2026 far below peak snowpack, raising concerns about water supply
item.description: California will begin 2026 with nearly a quarter of the snow needed to reach peak snowpack levels for the spring, a state official said Tuesday.

item.title: New Oakland police data shows crime trending downward in 2025, but some critics are skeptical
item.description: When it comes to crime, the City of Oakland is boosting double-digit drops in major categories. "If you are a victim of a crime, of course, you don't feel it," says Mayor Barbara Lee. "And so we want people to believe the data. And this is the data from year-to-year."
